task_instance: Given rough notes for a new-idea project (a small internal web tool for a 12-person support team to log and tag recurring customer complaints), produce the skill's deliverable: a project brief with goal, audience, scope, success measures, assumptions and next action, preserving supplied facts and leaving owners/dates/numeric targets unknown.
evidence: Read SKILL.md (a prompt/document skill; no bundled scripts, no external services required). Created sample input input_notes.txt (rough notes for a new project idea). Authored the deliverable project_brief.md following the skill's required structure. Verified with grep: all six required sections present (Goal, Audience, Scope, Success Measures, Assumptions, Next Action); supplied facts preserved verbatim (quarter horizon, top 5 per week, ~12 agents, existing internal server, no paid SaaS); owners, specific dates and numeric adoption targets explicitly labeled unknown/not supplied rather than fabricated; deferred the nice-to-have email summary; ended with one refinement suggestion. Files: input_notes.txt, project_brief.md, result.json in the work directory.
